name: case-only differences are not told apart
why: Without the case test a case change falls to punctuation. Must fail on the classifier test (Spirit In The Night).

name: the fold keeps punctuation
why: Then only a case change is punctuation-equal; Rosalita and Rock & Roll fall to 1–2 characters or different. Must fail on the classifier test.

name: the fold strips accents
why: Question B1 put Café/Cafe under 1–2 characters; an NFD fold that drops the marks makes it punctuation. Must fail on the classifier test.

name: the 1–2 characters threshold is 3
why: Nightttt/Night (three edits) must be different. Must fail on the classifier test.

name: the edit distance stops too early
why: An early stop at the row minimum must stop only past max; stopping at max turns every two-edit pair into different. Must fail on the classifier test (Nighttt/Night).

name: the 📊 kinds are never listed
why: The entries under the flag must be built. Must fail on the 📊 test.

name: the 📊 kinds are not indented
why: The mockup draws the kinds under the flag. Must fail on the 📊 test.

name: a kind entry matches every ≠ row
why: Its filter must keep only its kind, not the whole flag. Must fail on the 📊 test's filter steps.

name: a one-title note is counted as a kind
why: Question B3: a ≠ note naming one title has no kind. Counting it as different must fail on the 📊 test's counts.

name: the compare box has no headline
why: The kind must head the compare box. Must fail on the compare-box test.

name: the headline pill has one colour
why: Green for case and punctuation, amber for 1–2 characters, red for different (question B4). Must fail on the compare-box test.
